fields.subject: FW: URGENT: Service Restoration Request for Mail Ballot Tracking Service
fields.note: This is a critical escalation from the mail ballot tracking vendor. They are withholding service restoration until a signed access request and ticket (TICK-2026-1125) are approved by the Director and Legal. Without it, no further action can be taken. We must validate the request and secure approvals before proceeding.
fields.signature:
Doug Pruett
Absentee / Mail Ballot Manager

original.subject: URGENT: Service Restoration Request for Mail Ballot Tracking Service
original.body:
Dear Lisle County Board of Elections,

This is an official service interruption notice. The mail ballot tracking service (eTrack) has been suspended due to unresolved compliance violations under Section 8 of the Lisle County Emergency Operations Plan (LC-EOP-2025).

To restore service, you must submit a signed access request and a formal ticket (Ticket #TICK-2026-1125) approved by both the Director and the Legal Officer. The request must be processed within 24 hours, or service will remain offline.

Failure to comply will result in automatic escalation to the Election Assistance Commission and the Ohio Secretary of State’s office.

Please act immediately. This is not a routine request.

Sincerely,

eTrack Service Operations

Support Portal: https://support.trackmailballot.com
Case ID: EOP-8026-1024-001

Note: This message is sent from a third-party vendor system and not reviewed by the Board’s Public Information Officer or legal team.

instructorNote: This inject requires IT to initiate a formal ticket and secure dual approval from Legal and the Director. The vendor is not bluffing — the service will not resume without a signed access request and ticket number.
